title: Florida House, District 54
what_it_does: Represents District 54 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Incumbent Republican Randy Maggard defeated Michael Pultorak in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary. A closed party primary was held Aug. 18, 2026, which under Florida law means at least one other candidate (opposing-party, no-party or write-in) qualified for the Nov. 3 general election; that opponent's name could not be verified from search snippets.
verified_ballot_note: Tampa Bay Times (Aug. 18, 2026): 'HD 54 (Pasco County) Republican Primary: Randy Maggard (incumbent) defeated Michael Pultorak' (https://www.tampabay.com/news/florida-politics/elections/2026/08/18/florida-legislature-house-senate-legislative-results-primary-2026/). November opponent not found. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
